title: System-One adds value as a meta-policy over quantitative predictors
economic_mechanism: A bounded learned policy may combine heterogeneous predictors and abstain more effectively than fixed rules while remaining cheaper/faster than generative reasoning.
primary_outcome: incremental net execution-aware utility versus same-information LightGBM baseline
null_set: randomized policy conditional on same opportunity set
kill_criteria: No sealed out-of-sample net-utility improvement over LightGBM
